facts.fact: 她花了一个小时挑选要带去 Agency 的照片。
facts.anchor: I spend about an hour deciding which photos to take to the Agency.

facts.fact: 她又花半小时躲进卧室里排练：万一高管愿意见她，她该怎么说。
facts.anchor: Another thirty minutes hiding in my bedroom, rehearsing what I’ll say to the Executives if they’re willing to meet with me.

facts.fact: Daniel 看到她穿的那条裙子，低声脱口而出。
她不确定地问：不好看吗。
储物间窗外有一打以上像 Daniel 一样穿西装的、没有面目的形体坐在餐桌边，端着咖啡杯、看手表。
facts.anchor: More than a dozen formless human-size shapes wearing suits just like Daniel’s sit at cafeteria-style tables, holding coffee mugs and consulting wristwatches.

facts.fact: 对他们而言，人死不过是打卡上班、下班打卡的一份工。
facts.anchor: People dying is just a clock-in, clock-out job to them.

facts.fact: 她把手放在装着照片和手机的包上，说「豁出去了」。
facts.anchor: I put my hand on the bag carrying the photographs and my phone. “Here goes nothing,” I say.
